name: csas
description: C.S.A.S — Customer Service Automation System: bilingual (Arabic/English) AI support assistant with retrieval-augmented answers, human escalation and an evaluated ML loop.

scripts.up: node scripts/setup.mjs && docker compose up --build -d --wait && npm run seed
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run secrets:scan && npm run scan:personal-data && npm run audit:checklist && npm run check:contrast && npm run test
scripts.break-glass: docker compose --profile seed run --rm --build seed node apps/server/dist/cli/break-glass-main.js
scripts.seed:fast: docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed node apps/server/dist/seed/index.js --fast
scripts.seed:native: npm run build -w @csas/shared && npm run build -w @csas/server && npm run seed -w @csas/server
scripts.lint:ml: cd apps/ml && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy app tests

*.{py,pyi}: sh -c 'cd apps/ml && uv run ruff check --fix --force-exclude'
sh -c 'cd apps/ml && uv run ruff format --force-exclude'
